avis.titre: Good, not great for dry, sensitive skin
avis.texte: On paper, this is probably the most ideal cream for dry sensitive skin, however I found in my experience (dry skin in a dry enviroment) it didn't provide moisture that would last for more than 12 hours at best, which wasn't ideal as i don't enjoy having to apply lotion multiple times a day. Also, the moisture it did provide required me to use a sizeable amount everyday, which meant that I ran out of the cream in about 2 months, which seemed a bit too fast for how expensive the cream is. Additionally, the packaging--while nice--made it difficult to get the last third of the cream out. Finally, a minor issue which affected me was that it did make my skin quite sticky for at least a couple hours after application which over time became a bit annoying. That being said if my skin was irritated (burning/itchy) I wouldn't say it was the best at treating it.

Its thick & rich but thats great for winter eczema. It has. Soothed & moisturized my super dry skin. Less redness, less tightness, lesss bumps. I use this at night after shower bc its thick & it takes a bit to soak in, but in the morning my skin feels amazing.

avis.titre: Effective at a good price point
avis.texte: Bioderma Atoderm Intensive Balm is a highly effective solution for dry, sensitive, and irritated skin. Its nourishing formula, enriched with glycerin and soothing agents, restores the skin's barrier and provides long-lasting hydration. The balm absorbs quickly, leaving skin soft and smooth without being greasy. It's particularly beneficial for conditions like eczema, reducing itching and inflammation. Plus, its affordable price makes it a great value for high-quality skincare. Overall, it's an excellent option for anyone seeking reliable hydration at a reasonable cost.

I am a fan of BIODERMA and this atoderm intensive balm is a rich and nonstick. I applied on my super dry hands and it absorbed quickly and left moist without any fragrance. I like to carry it in my purse and apply frequently!!

avis.titre: Amazing for itchy and dry skin
avis.texte: I've been using Bioderma Atoderm for a few weeks now, and I'm thoroughly impressed with the results. As someone with dry and sensitive skin, finding a product that hydrates without causing irritation has always been a challenge, but Atoderm has completely changed my skin care routine. The texture of the cream is rich and creamy, yet it absorbs quickly without feeling greasy or heavy. My skin feels instantly nourished and smooth after application, and it stays hydrated throughout the day. I love that it doesn't have a strong scent, which is perfect for sensitive skin like mine. After using it consistently, I've noticed a significant improvement in the overall appearance and texture of my skin. It's much softer and more supple, and any dryness or tightness I used to feel has disappeared. What's even better is that Bioderma Atoderm is designed for all skin types, including those prone to eczema or dermatitis, so I feel confident in using it daily. It's also free of parabens, which is a huge plus. I absolutely recommend it!!! Overall, I highly recommend Bioderma Atoderm for anyone looking to deeply hydrate and repair dry, sensitive skin. It's definitely become a staple in my skincare routine.

avis.titre: Great for body, slightly heavy for face
avis.texte: Great moisturizer. I live in a dry climate and it has helped my skin this winter. It is scent free which is also a plus. I was hoping to be able to use on my face, but it's a little too heavy/greasy. However, it is great for elbows and feet.

It is definitely a thicker, heavier lotion but it goes on so smoothly. It also dries nicely and doesn't leave grease stains on anything. It also pairs nicely with other lotions/moisturizers. It can be layered with other skin care and it doesn't pill. It doesn't really have a scent. It's extremely mild and it's a clean almost soap smell. I used this on my DRY, CRACKED feet. It definitely helped heal my heels. I used it 3-4x a week before I went to bed . I'd rub the Bioderma all over my feet but especially my heels. By the end of the 2nd week I could tell big difference with my feet. My heels were hydrated, no dead flakey skin, no cracks in my heels. I enjoyed using this product and would definitely recommend it to others.

avis.titre: Effective at reducing inflammation and itching
avis.texte: The Atoderm Intensive balm is very effective at reducing inflammation and itching. In conjunction with topical steroids it was very helpful at reducing the symptoms, unfortunately it did not make the rash disappear completely.
